news.headline: Ethan Ampadu BIDS FAREWELL TO SPEZIA
news.details: Ethan Ampadu leaves Spezia, where Gianluca Vialli (🇮🇹) once starred. Legacy at Spezia: 15G / 28A. New chapter awaits!

news.headline: Ethan Ampadu JOINS CHELSEA — Following in Frank Lampard's footsteps!
news.details: Ethan Ampadu has signed for Chelsea! The great Frank Lampard (🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿) played here from 2001-2014, scoring 211 goals. His honours: 1x UCL, 3x PL, Club's all-time top scorer. Can Ethan Ampadu match or surpass that legacy? The journey begins now!

news.headline: Ethan Ampadu JOINS CHELSEA — Following in Didier Drogba's footsteps!
news.details: Ethan Ampadu has signed for Chelsea! The great Didier Drogba (🇨🇮) played here from 2004-2012, scoring 164 goals. His honours: 1x UCL, 4x PL, UCL Final hero 2012. Can Ethan Ampadu match or surpass that legacy? The journey begins now!
